name: vanta/meminfo
description: PHP extension that dumps the content of PHP memory as JSON, to hunt down memory leaks

configure-options.name: with-meminfo-version
configure-options.description: Version reported by phpversion('meminfo') and phpinfo() (default: the content of extension/VERSION)

configure-options.name: with-meminfo-s3
configure-options.description: S3 dependencies: auto (default, prepares pinned AWS CRT libraries), no (disable S3), or an existing static library prefix

configure-options.name: with-meminfo-copyright-year
configure-options.description: Last year of the copyright notice (default: the year of SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH when set, else the current year)
